viewer.blur_amount: default=12,  larger values than 12 will increase processing load quite a bit
viewer.blur_zoom: default=1.0, must be >= 1.0 which expands the backgorund to just fill the space around the image
viewer.blur_edges: default=False, use blurred version of image to fill edges - will override FIT = False
viewer.edge_alpha: default=0.5, background colour at edge. 1.0 would show reflection of image
viewer.background: default=[0.2, 0.2, 0.3, 1.0], RGBA to fill edges when fitting
viewer.blend_type: default="blend", choices=["blend", "burn", "bump"], type of blend the shader can do
viewer.show_text_fm: default "%b %d, %Y", format to show date over the image
viewer.show_text_tm: default=20.0, time to show text over image with file name
viewer.show_text: default="title caption name date folder location", show text, include combination of words: title, caption name, date, location, folder
viewer.text_justify: text justification L, C or R
viewer.text_bkg_hgt: default=0.25 (0.0-1.0), percentage of screen height for text background texture
viewer.text_opacity: default=1.0 (0.0-1.0), alpha value of text overlay
viewer.text_x_margin: default=100 pixels in from edge of screen or half screen if portrait pairs
viewer.text_y_margin: default=0 this is additional margin to half the font height. A negative value would move text down
viewer.fit: default=False, True => scale image so all visible and leave 'gaps' False => crop image so no 'gaps'
viewer.video_fit_display: default=False, True => scale video to match display size (video may have distortion) False => scale video without distortion (video may have black bars)
viewer.max_software_decode_resolution: default="1280x720", maximale Auflösung für Software-Video-Dekodierung. Videos, die diese Auflösung und die Hardware-Limits überschreiten, werden übersprungen.
viewer.kenburns: default=False, will set fit->False and blur_edges->False
viewer.display_x: offset from left of screen (can be negative)
viewer.display_y: offset from top of screen (can be negative)
viewer.display_w: width of display surface (null->None will use max returned by hardware)
viewer.display_power: default=0. choices=[0, 1, 2, 3], 0 => legacy `vcgencmd`, 1 => `xset`, 2 => 'wlr-randr', 3 => .../drm/card.../status (needed for multiple screens?) to blank the display
viewer.display_hdmi: default="HDMI-A-1" which is marked "HDMI 0" and is nearest the power. Change to "HDMI-A-2" if you use "HDMI 1"
viewer.use_glx: default=False. Set to True on linux with xserver running. NB use_sdl2 might need to be False for this to work.
viewer.use_sdl2: default=True. pysdl2 can use display without xserver, it should be installed as a dependency of pi3d but might need `sudo apt install libsdl2-dev` if picframe gives errors about missing sdl2
viewer.mat_images: default=0.01, True, automatically mat all images. False, don't automatically mat any images. Real value, auto-mat all images with aspect ratio difference > than value
viewer.mat_type: default=null, A string containing the mat types to choose from when matting images. It can consist of any or all of 'float float_polaroid float_color_wrap single_bevel double_bevel double_flat' (null or '' will use all mat types)
viewer.outer_mat_color: default=null, Color of the outer mat as an RGB list. null will auto-select a reasonable color based on the image.
viewer.inner_mat_color: default=null, Color of the inner mat as an RGB list. null will auto-select a reasonable color based on the image.
viewer.outer_mat_border: default=75, Minimum outer mat border in pixels
viewer.inner_mat_border: default=40, Minimum inner mat border in pixels (for styles that use it)
viewer.outer_mat_use_texture: default=True, True uses a texture for the outer mat. False creates a solid-color outer mat.
viewer.inner_mat_use_texture: default=False, True uses a texture for the inner mat. False creates a solid-color inner mat.
viewer.show_clock: default=False, True shows clock overlay. False does not show clock overlay
viewer.clock_justify: default="R", clock justification L, C, or R
viewer.clock_format: default="%-I:%M", strftime format for clock string
viewer.clock_opacity: default=1.0 (0.0-1.0), alpha value of clock overlay
viewer.clock_top_bottom: default="T" ("T", "B"), whether to display clock at top or bottom of screen
viewer.clock_wdt_offset_pct: default=3.0 (1.0-10.0), used to calclate pixels between clock text and side of screen
viewer.clock_hgt_offset_pct: default=3.0 (1.0-10.0), used to calclate pixels between clock text and top/bottom of screen If text is found in the ramdisk /dev/shm/clock.txt then it will be displayed under the time
viewer.menu_autohide_tm: default=10.0, time in seconds to show menu before auto hiding (0 disables auto hiding)
viewer.geo_suppress_list: default=None, substrings to remove from the location text

model.follow_links: default=False, By default, picframe will not walk down into symbolic links that resolve to directories. Set follow_links to True to visit directories pointed to by symlinks, on systems that support them.
model.no_files_img: default="PictureFrame2020img.jpg", image to show if none selected
model.subdirectory: default="", Unterordner von pic_dir - kann per Remote oder MQTT/Home Assistant geändert werden
model.recent_n: default=7 (days), when shuffling file change date more recent than this number of days play before the rest
model.time_delay: default=200.0, Zeit zwischen zwei Medienstarts - kann per Remote oder MQTT/Home Assistant geändert werden
model.fade_time: default=10.0, Überblendzeit - kann per Remote oder MQTT/Home Assistant geändert werden
model.update_interval: default=2.0, time in seconds to wait between two consecutive scans for new files
model.shuffle: default=True, Zufallswiedergabe - kann per Remote oder MQTT/Home Assistant geändert werden
model.shuffle_mode: default=standard, shuffle mode used when shuffle is enabled. Choices: standard, fewer_repeats.
model.sort_cols: default='fname ASC' can be any columns in the table with optional ASC or DESC separated by commas fname, last_modified, file_id, orientation, exif_datetime, f_number, exposure_time, iso, focal_length, make, model, lens, rating, latitude, longitude, width, height, title, caption, tags, is_portrait, location
model.image_attr: Metadatenattribute für UI/MQTT-Payloads. "PICFRAME GPS" liefert GPS lon/lat, "PICFRAME LOCATION" liefert Reverse Geocoding (load_geoloc muss True sein)
model.load_geoloc: get location information from open street map NB if you switch this on (recommended)
model.geo_key: then you **MUST** change the geo_key to something unique to you i.e. use your email address
model.locale: "locale -a" shows the installed locales which could used
model.location_filter: default="" filter clause for image location
model.tags_filter: default="" filter clause for image tags
model.log_level: default=WARNING, could beDEBUG, INFO, WARNING, ERROR, CRITICAL
model.log_file: default="" for debugging set this to the path to a file. NB logging messages will appended indefinitely so don't forget this. You will need to tidy it up later
model.image_extensions: Liste der Bild-Dateierweiterungen, die in die Playlist aufgenommen werden sollen.
model.video_extensions: Liste der Video-Dateierweiterungen, die in die Playlist aufgenommen werden sollen.

mqtt.use_mqtt: default=False. Auf true setzen, um Home Assistant MQTT Discovery und Steuerung zu aktivieren
mqtt.port: default=8883 for tls, 1883 else (tls must be "" then !!!!!)
mqtt.tls: filename including path to your ca.crt. If not used, must be set to "" !!!!
mqtt.device_id: default="picframe" unique id of device. change if there is more than one PictureFrame
mqtt.device_url: optionale URL, die in Home Assistant Geräteinformationen angezeigt wird; "" blendet sie aus.

http.auth: default=False. Set True if enable basic auth for http
http.password: password for basic auth. If set null generate random password in file basic_auth.txt in parent http directory
http.websocket_broadcast_rate_limit: default=10.0, maximale Anzahl von Statusaktualisierungen, die pro Sekunde gesendet werden
http.command_debounce_ms: default=200, Verzögerung in Millisekunden zum Entprellen hochfrequenter eingehender Befehle
http.cors_allowed_origins: default=["*"]. Sicherheitseinstellung, um anderen Websites die Verbindung zu Ihrem Rahmen zu erlauben. Beispiel: ["http://localhost:5173"] für lokale Entwicklung oder ["*"] um alle zuzulassen.
